signal_summary: The existing ZEC paper thesis gained an independent roadmap/product confirmation from the NU7 coinholder vote, but the initial news-driven price spike did not persist. This is a material thesis improvement, not an add signal yet.

ecosystem_regime_evidence.comment: Real movement into privacy pools remains positive and is not an incentive metric, but the 7d pace has slowed from +17,561 ZEC at the Sep 15 paper entry.

nu7_confirmation.technical_effect: Draft ZIP 218 reduces target block spacing from 75s to 25s, keeps mined ZEC/day unchanged by adjusting per-block subsidy, targets more than 2x Orchard throughput, and reduces maximum light-client shielded-sync DoS burden.

discretionary_flow_quality.incentive_discount: Shielded-pool balances require real ZEC movement and the NU7 vote is not a points/quest/yield-farming campaign. No incentive credit is assigned.
discretionary_flow_quality.caveat: The vote is ZEC-weighted rather than wallet-count-weighted, so participation does not prove broad independent-holder diversity.

leadership_rotation.comment: ZEC traded to roughly $1,223 after the vote/short-squeeze catalyst but retraced to roughly $1,127 by this scan. That failed persistence test blocks an add despite stronger fundamentals.

wallet_quality.comment: No new independently funded, historically selective accumulation cohort was verified this run. The two previously observed exchange-withdrawal paths remain supporting evidence, with beneficial-owner independence still unproven.

narrative_news.positive: NU7 now has unusually strong coinholder support for faster confirmations, unchanged Bitcoin-style halving economics, delayed NSM reissuance and rapid shipping.
narrative_news.risk: High-profile ZEC promotion remains concentrated enough to treat influencer attention as crowding risk rather than confirmation; the immediate move also included short-covering.

liquidity_executability.comment: CoinGecko aggregates ZEC across 49 exchanges and 83 markets with roughly $925M of 24h turnover; executable liquidity is ample for the paper portfolio.

details: Native PoW asset: honeypot, token-contract mint/freeze, creator LP-control and deployer-privilege gates do not apply.
Maximum supply remains 21M ZEC; the 25-second proposal explicitly keeps mined ZEC/day unchanged by reducing subsidy per block.
Privacy regulatory/listing risk and opaque beneficial ownership remain material.
NU7 coinholder results are advisory until developers implement, test and include the changes in a network upgrade.

major_uncertainties: NU7 implementation is not automatic or binding from the vote alone.
Vote weight is by ZEC, so holder-count diversity and independence cannot be inferred from participation.
The initial catalyst rally retraced sharply instead of persisting.
7d net shielded inflow remains positive but has decelerated since the paper entry.
No fresh selective-wallet accumulation confirmation was found.
Broad macro/Fed event risk remains high.
why_signal_matters_now: This is the first independent product/governance confirmation after the Sep 15 paper starter: the asset's privacy-use thesis is now paired with a credible near-term UX/throughput roadmap. But the framework requires persistence and independent confirmation before scaling; the post-news price rejection, slower shielded inflow and unchanged wallet-quality score keep the position at starter size.

paper_action.reason: Positive independent thesis confirmation is offset by failed price persistence, no fresh selective-wallet cohort and implementation uncertainty.
